story.heading: From Vision to Landmark
paragraphs: Founded in 2009 by Rajendra Babu with a small team of five passionate builders, Saanidhya Builders started with a single apartment project in Gandhipuram, Coimbatore.

Today, we have grown into a 200-member strong organisation delivering over 500 projects spanning luxury villas, commercial complexes, industrial buildings, and landmark residential communities across Tamil Nadu.
Our growth is built on a simple foundation: doing what is right for the client, every single time.
